Mentioned in Rand's thoughts regarding romantic conflict with Selene. Believed to be in Tar Valon learning to be Aes Sedai.

appearances.whereabouts: Camped on mountainside near Kinslayer's Dagger, then infiltrates Fain's camp, returns to own camp, plans to head to Cairhien
appearances.notable_actions: Infiltrates Fain's camp with Loial, retrieves the Horn of Valere and Shadar Logoth dagger, fights and kills multiple Trollocs using sword forms while struggling against saidin's pull, decides to go to Cairhien rather than return north
appearances.demeanor: conflicted, drawn to Selene but guilty about Egwene, struggling with the void and saidin, determined yet uncertain, contemplating madness

appearances.whereabouts: Camped on mountainside with Rand's party
appearances.notable_actions: Attempts to seduce Rand (has him help with dress buttons, wears his shirt), urges him toward glory and taking the Horn, knows how to open the chest, translates Old Tongue inscription on Horn, persuades Rand to go to Cairhien rather than return north, warns about danger of the dagger
appearances.demeanor: seductive, persuasive, focused on power and glory, mysteriously knowledgeable, possessive of Rand's attention

appearances.whereabouts: Camped on mountainside, accompanies Rand into Fain's camp
appearances.notable_actions: Accompanies Rand on infiltration, carries the Horn of Valere chest out of enemy camp, runs at horse-trotting speed while pulling his horse, secures chest to his saddle
appearances.demeanor: loyal and brave despite visible fear, confused by some of Rand's statements about madness, determined to help despite danger

appearances.whereabouts: Camped on mountainside, keeps watch from stone outcrop
appearances.notable_actions: Spots Darkfriend fire in the hills, reports to Rand, guards Selene while Rand and Loial retrieve Horn, checks for pursuit from outcrop
appearances.demeanor: anxious about pursuit, deferential to Rand and Selene, dutiful in his watch, fearful of the dagger's taint

appearances.whereabouts: Camped in hills below Kinslayer's Dagger with Darkfriends and Trollocs
appearances.notable_actions: Discovers Horn stolen, rouses camp to search, kills/wounds Trolloc that failed him, rants about al'Thor and vengeance, orders all Trollocs gathered, reveals he can sense al'Thor's location through Dark One's gift
appearances.demeanor: mad, vengeful, obsessed, cackling, ranting, violent toward his own followers, consumed by hatred for al'Thor

appearances.whereabouts: Somewhere to the north with twenty lances, pursuing the Horn
appearances.notable_actions: Not present but mentioned as pursuing; Rand hopes he will arrive in Cairhien

appearances.whereabouts: With Rand on the mountainside and during infiltration
appearances.notable_actions: Ridden by Rand to area near Fain's camp, tied up while Rand infiltrates on foot
